description: This file defines a sealed class 'UnavailableExceptionFallbackException' within the 'Orleans.Serialization' namespace. The class represents an exception used during serialization scenarios when the exception type is unavailable during deserialization. It includes multiple constructors, a property to hold serialized data, and methods to retrieve diagnostic information.
